verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs built-in background automation: daily continuous monitoring with failing-test alerts, automated evidence collection across 100+ integrations, and automatic shadow-IT detection. Users can configure recurring access and vendor reviews, reminders, and Jira/Slack task creation, and the API and headless MCP access (for CI jobs and scripts) allow externally scripted automation. However, these are mostly predefined platform automations with schedule and notification settings, not user-authored autonomous automations or agents, and custom background workflows need external tooling. Missing for 10: a native user-defined automation or workflow builder, autonomous AI agents acting in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
